entry shows the signature from the client's own source, then the
matching CLI command and MCP tool where one exists.

Entries marked **(nightly)** are not in the latest release (26.8.21);
**(changed in nightly)** means the documented signature differs from that release.
Signatures come from the latest nightly build. See
[What's in Nightly](../../nightly.md). The same data for every surface
is in the [API matrix](../../reference/api-matrix.md) and in
[`/api.json`](/api.json).

Listen for new page events

`onPage(callback: (page: Page) => void): void;`

**`browser.onPopup(cb)`**

Listen for popup events

`onPopup(callback: (page: Page) => void): void;`

Remove all event listeners

`removeAllListeners(event?: 'page' | 'popup'): void;`

Remove all listeners for a given event, or all events if no event specified. Supported events: 'page', 'popup'.

**`page.find(locator, opts?)`**

Find a single element by description (a bare string), css, tag, semantic locator, or reference image; strategy auto, cv, vlm, or tree **(changed in nightly)**

`find(selector: string | SelectorOptions, options?: FindOptions): FluentElement;`

Find an element. A string is a natural-language description; an options object gives an exact locator (css, tag, role, text, ...) or a reference image. Waits for the element to exist.

CLI `vibium find <description>` · MCP `browser_find`

**`page.findAll(locator, opts?)`**

Find all matching elements, same locator forms **(changed in nightly)**

`findAll(selector: string | SelectorOptions, options?: FindOptions): Promise<Element[]>;`

Find all elements matching a description, image, css, or semantic options. Waits up to the timeout for at least one match, then returns an empty array if there is none. A timeout of 0 checks once without waiting. Each element carries a snapshot of its tag, text, and box taken at findAll time, readable via `el.info` with no further round trips: els.map(el =\> el.info.text). Live reads like el.text() re-resolve the element and fail if the page has changed since findAll.

CLI `vibium find --all <description>` · MCP `browser_find_all`

**`page.expose(name, fn)`**

Expose a function to the page

`expose(name: string, fn: string | ((...args: unknown[]) => unknown)): Promise<void>;`

Expose a function on window. Pass a function to expose a host callback: the page calls window\[name\](...args), this function runs here, and its return value resolves the page's promise. Arguments and results cross as JSON. Pass a string to inject it as JS source instead, defining window\[name\] inside the page. Either form survives navigation, and re-exposing a name replaces it.

Register a route handler

Listen for dialogs

`onDialog(handler: (dialog: Dialog) => void): void;`

Listen for console messages

Listen for page errors

**`page.onDownload(fn)`**

**`page.onWebSocket(fn)`**

Subscribe to WebSocket events

`onWebSocket(fn: (ws: WebSocketInfo) => void): void;`

Listen for WebSocket connections opened by the page. Monitoring is installed in the engine before the next command on this connection is sent, so a socket opened by the very next call cannot be missed (#351).

## BrowserContext

**`context.newPage()`**

Create a page in a context

`newPage(): Promise<Page>;`

Create a new page (tab) in this context.

**`context.close()`**

Close the context

`close(): Promise<void>;`

Close this context and all its pages.

**`context.cookies(urls?)`**

Get cookies

- `swipe(direction: SwipeDirection, options?: SwipeOptions): Promise<void>;`
- `swipe(x1: number, y1: number, x2: number, y2: number, durationMs?: number): Promise<void>;`

Swipe in a direction, or from (x1, y1) to (x2, y2). The finger stays down for the move, so the gesture reads as a swipe/fling rather than two taps. swipe('up') // from the center, half the viewport swipe('up', { from: 'bottom', speed: 'fast' }) // phone home gesture via Roadie swipe(40, 100, 240, 100, 200) // coordinates, 200ms

## Clock

**`clock.install(opts?)`**

Install fake timers

`install(options?: ClockInstallOptions): Promise<void>;`

Install fake clock, overriding Date, setTimeout, setInterval, etc.

MCP `page_clock_install`

**`clock.fastForward(ticks)`**

Fast-forward time

`fastForward(ticks: number): Promise<void>;`

Jump forward by ticks ms, fire each due timer at most once.

MCP `page_clock_fast_forward`

**`clock.runFor(ticks)`**

Run timers for a duration

`runFor(ticks: number): Promise<void>;`

Advance ticks ms, firing all callbacks systematically (including interval reschedules).

**`clock.pauseAt(time)`**

Pause clock at a time

Jump to a specific time and pause — no timers fire until resumed/advanced.

MCP `page_clock_pause_at`

**`clock.resume()`**

Resume clock

`resume(): Promise<void>;`

Resume real-time progression from current fake time.

MCP `page_clock_resume`

**`clock.setFixedTime(time)`**

Set fixed fake time

`setFixedTime(time: number | string | Date): Promise<void>;`

Freeze Date.now() at a value permanently. Timers still run.

MCP `page_clock_set_fixed_time`

**`clock.setSystemTime(time)`**

Set system time

`setSystemTime(time: number | string | Date): Promise<void>;`

Set Date.now() without triggering timers.

MCP `page_clock_set_system_time`

**`clock.setTimezone(tz)`**

Set timezone

`setTimezone(timezone: string): Promise<void>;`

Override the browser timezone. Pass an IANA timezone ID, or empty string to reset to system default.

## Recording

**`recording.stopChunk(opts?)`**

**`recording.startGroup(name, opts?)`**

Start a logical group

**`recording.stopGroup()`**

## Run and Check

**`browser.check(claim, opts?)`**

Independently verify the active session or a saved archive **(nightly)**

`check(claim: string, options?: CheckOptions): Promise<CheckResult>;`

Independently verify this session, or inspect a saved archive.

CLI `vibium check <claim>` · MCP `vibium_check`

**`page.check(claim, opts?)`**

Independently verify a pinned page or a saved archive **(nightly)**

`check(claim: string, options?: CheckOptions): Promise<CheckResult>;`

Verify this exact page, or inspect a read-only archive.

**`browser.run(goal, opts?)`**

Accomplish a goal in the active browser session **(nightly)**

`run(goal: string, options?: RunOptions): Promise<RunResult>;`

Accomplish a live browser goal; provider settings are read in the runtime.

CLI `vibium run <goal>` · MCP `vibium_run`

**`page.run(goal, opts?)`**

Accomplish a goal on a pinned page **(nightly)**

`run(goal: string, options?: RunOptions): Promise<RunResult>;`

Accomplish a live browser goal; provider settings are read in the runtime.

## Types

Option and result types named in the signatures above.

### `A11yNode`

```ts
interface A11yNode {
    role: string;
    name?: string;
    value?: string | number;
    description?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    expanded?: boolean;
    focused?: boolean;
    checked?: boolean | 'mixed';
    pressed?: boolean | 'mixed';
    selected?: boolean;
    required?: boolean;
    readonly?: boolean;
    level?: number;
    valuemin?: number;
    valuemax?: number;
    children?: A11yNode[];
}
```

### `ActionOptions`

```ts
interface ActionOptions {
    /** Timeout in milliseconds for actionability checks. Default: 30000 */
    timeout?: number;
}
```

### `BoundingBox`

```ts
interface BoundingBox {
    x: number;
    y: number;
    width: number;
    height: number;
}
```

### `Browser`

```ts
interface Browser {
    (goal: string, options?: RunOptions): Promise<RunResult>;
}
```

### `CheckOptions`

```ts
interface CheckOptions extends ModelOptions {
    /** Read-only archive on the runtime host. */
    record?: string;
    /** Site under test: opened first unless the current page already shares its
     * origin; relative navigation paths resolve against it. Not the AI provider
     * endpoint; that is aiBaseURL. */
    baseURL?: string;
}
```

### `CheckResult`

```ts
interface CheckResult {
    status: 'passed' | 'failed' | 'inconclusive';
    claim: string;
    summary: string;
    /** Machine-readable cause of an inconclusive verdict. */
    reason?: 'action_limit' | 'insufficient_evidence' | 'safety_stop' | 'archive_missing_evidence';
    evidence: {
        type: 'observation';
        summary: string;
    }[];
}
```

### `ClockInstallOptions`

```ts
interface ClockInstallOptions {
    time?: number | string | Date;
    timezone?: string;
}
```

### `CloseHandler`

```ts
type CloseHandler = (code?: number, reason?: string) => void;
```

### `Cookie`

```ts
interface Cookie {
    name: string;
    value: string;
    domain: string;
    path: string;
    size: number;
    httpOnly: boolean;
    secure: boolean;
    sameSite: string;
    expiry?: number;
}
```

### `ElementInfo`

```ts
interface ElementInfo {
    tag: string;
    text: string;
    box: BoundingBox;
    /** The @eN ref find registered; the CLI and MCP address the same element by it. */
    ref?: string;
    role?: string;
    /** Accessible name. */
    name?: string;
    /** What backs the match: dom, tree, image, or vlm. */
    source?: string;
    /** The DOM selector of a DOM-backed match. Absent for a visual region. */
    selector?: string;
    /** Diagnostics, when the find asked for details. */
    details?: Record<string, unknown>;
}
```

### `FindOptions`

```ts
interface FindOptions {
    /** Timeout in milliseconds to wait for element. Default: 30000 */
    timeout?: number;
}
```

### `FindStrategy`

```ts
type FindStrategy = 'auto' | 'cv' | 'vlm' | 'tree';
```

### `FluentElement`

```ts
type FluentElement = Promise<Element> & {
    click(options?: ActionOptions): Promise<void>;
```

### `MessageHandler`

```ts
type MessageHandler = (data: string, info: {
    direction: 'sent' | 'received';
```

### `ModelOptions`

```ts
interface ModelOptions {
    provider?: 'openai' | 'xai' | 'anthropic' | 'google' | 'openai-compatible' | 'local';
    model?: string;
    /** The AI provider's API base URL (the model endpoint, not the site under
     * test). Empty string resets the endpoint to the provider default. */
    aiBaseURL?: string;
    /** Empty string clears an inherited effort. */
    reasoningEffort?: string;
}
```

### `OriginState`

```ts
interface OriginState {
    origin: string;
    localStorage: {
        name: string;
        value: string;
    }[];
    sessionStorage: {
        name: string;
        value: string;
    }[];
}
```

### `Page`

```ts
interface Page {
    (goal: string, options?: RunOptions): Promise<RunResult>;
}
```

### `PdfOptions`

```ts
interface PdfOptions {
    /** Landscape orientation (default: portrait). */
    landscape?: boolean;
    /** Print scale, 0.1-2 (default: 1). */
    scale?: number;
    /** Print background graphics (default: false). */
    background?: boolean;
    /** Top margin in cm (default: 1). */
    marginTop?: number;
    /** Bottom margin in cm (default: 1). */
    marginBottom?: number;
    /** Left margin in cm (default: 1). */
    marginLeft?: number;
    /** Right margin in cm (default: 1). */
    marginRight?: number;
    /** Page width in cm (default: 21.59). */
    pageWidth?: number;
    /** Page height in cm (default: 27.94). */
    pageHeight?: number;
    /** Pages to print, e.g. [1, '3-5'] (default: all). */
    pageRanges?: Array<number | string>;
    /** Shrink content to fit the page width (default: true). */
    shrinkToFit?: boolean;
}
```

### `RecordingResult`

```ts
interface RecordingResult {
    /** Where the zip landed. Absent for bytes-only recordings. */
    path?: string;
    /** The zip itself. Present only for bytes-only recordings (start path: null). */
    bytes?: Buffer;
    steps?: number;
    durationMs?: number;
    videos?: RecordingVideoSummary[];
    /** Why no video was recorded (video omitted on an engine without support). */
    videoUnavailable?: string;
    /** Where the zip was uploaded, when stop() asked for it. */
    upload?: RecordingUpload;
}
```

### `RecordingStartOptions`

```ts
interface RecordingStartOptions {
    name?: string;
    screenshots?: boolean;
    snapshots?: boolean;
    sources?: boolean;
    title?: string;
    bidi?: boolean;
    /** Screenshot format: 'jpeg' (default, faster/smaller) or 'png' (lossless). */
    format?: 'jpeg' | 'png';
    /** JPEG quality 0.0-1.0 (default 0.5). Ignored for PNG. */
    quality?: number;
    /**
     * Video track (Firefox 154+, local browsers). Omitted: record video if the
     * engine supports it; the stop result reports videoUnavailable otherwise.
     * `true` (or explicit dimensions): start fails if the engine can't deliver.
     * `false`: off.
     */
    video?: boolean | RecordingVideoOptions;
    /**
     * Where the recording zip lands at stop. Defaults to a timestamped
     * record-YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.zip in the working directory, so a rerun never
     * clobbers the previous one. `null` selects bytes-only capture: no file
     * is written and the recording is lost if the session closes before
     * stop().
     */
    path?: string | null;
}
```

### `RecordingStopOptions`

```ts
interface RecordingStopOptions {
    /** Overrides the path declared at start. */
    path?: string;
    /**
     * Also upload the zip to a station's Record Store: `true` for the station
     * the browser is connected through, or a station URL. Needs the API key
     * the connection was made with; the zip still lands at its path either
     * way, and the result's `upload` says where it went.
     */
    upload?: boolean | string;
}
```

### `RecordingUpload`

```ts
interface RecordingUpload {
    /** Where the station serves the file. */
    url: string;
    sha256: string;
    size: number;
    /** The hold the recording was filed under, when the station knows one. */
    hold?: string;
    device?: string;
    /** The id of the file event the station signed for it. */
    event?: string;
}
```

### `RecordingVideoOptions`

```ts
interface RecordingVideoOptions {
    /** Video width in pixels (defaults to the viewport). */
    width?: number;
    /** Video height in pixels (defaults to the viewport). */
    height?: number;
    /** Video frame rate (engine default if omitted). */
    frameRate?: number;
    /**
     * On a remote browser connection, 'keep' records anyway and leaves the
     * video on the remote host: the stop result and zip manifest carry its
     * remotePath, and retrieval and cleanup are yours. Ignored on local
     * connections.
     */
    remote?: 'keep';
}
```

### `RecordingVideoSummary`

```ts
interface RecordingVideoSummary {
    context: string;
    durationMs: number;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    /** Where a remote-keep video lives on the remote host. */
    remotePath?: string;
    /** Set when the video pipeline died; the zip delivered without or with a partial video. */
    error?: string;
    /** True when the video file also holds what the recording said and heard. */
    audio?: boolean;
}
```

### `RunOptions`

```ts
interface RunOptions extends ModelOptions {
    /** Site under test: opened first unless the current page already shares its
     * origin; relative navigation paths resolve against it. Not the AI provider
     * endpoint; that is aiBaseURL. */
    baseURL?: string;
}
```

### `RunResult`

```ts
interface RunResult {
    status: 'completed' | 'not_completed';
    goal: string;
    summary: string;
    /** Machine-readable cause of a not_completed result. */
    reason?: 'action_limit' | 'missing_information' | 'safety_stop';
    evidence: {
        type: 'observation';
        summary: string;
    }[];
}
```

### `ScreenshotOptions`

```ts
interface ScreenshotOptions {
    /** Capture full scrollable page instead of just the viewport. */
    fullPage?: boolean;
    /** Capture a specific region of the page. */
    clip?: {
        x: number;
        y: number;
        width: number;
        height: number;
    };
}
```

### `SelectorOptions`

```ts
interface SelectorOptions {
    /** Natural-language description, e.g. 'the Add to Cart button'. Stands alone. */
    description?: string;
    /** Reference image to locate on screen: a file path, a data: URL, or PNG/JPEG bytes. Stands alone. */
    image?: string | Uint8Array;
    /** CSS selector. Exact; never sent to a model. */
    css?: string;
    /** Same as css. */
    selector?: string;
    /** HTML tag name. */
    tag?: string;
    /** Accessible-name filter: the text, label, alt, or aria-label a person reads the element by. */
    name?: string;
    /**
     * auto (default): page evidence first, a vision model only when needed
     * and configured. cv: local image matching only. vlm: vision model only.
     * tree: the page's DOM/accessibility tree only.
     */
    strategy?: FindStrategy;
    /** Include diagnostics in info.details. */
    details?: boolean;
    /** Per-call AI overrides, as for check and run. */
    provider?: string;
    model?: string;
    aiBaseURL?: string;
    reasoningEffort?: string;
    role?: string;
    text?: string;
    label?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    alt?: string;
    title?: string;
    testid?: string;
    xpath?: string;
    near?: string;
    timeout?: number;
}
```

### `SetCookieParam`

```ts
interface SetCookieParam {
    name: string;
    value: string;
    domain?: string;
    url?: string;
    path?: string;
    httpOnly?: boolean;
    secure?: boolean;
    sameSite?: string;
    expiry?: number;
}
```

### `StartOptions`

```ts
interface StartOptions {
    /** Browser engine to launch: 'chrome' (default) or 'firefox'. */
    engine?: 'chrome' | 'firefox';
    /**
     * Release channel of the engine to install and run, e.g. 'beta'.
     * Currently honored by Firefox only.
     */
    channel?: string;
    headless?: boolean;
    headers?: Record<string, string>;
    /** Extra alwaysMatch capabilities for classic WebDriver endpoints
     *  (cloud grids take their config this way, via vendor-prefixed capability keys). */
    caps?: Record<string, unknown>;
    executablePath?: string;
    /**
     * Extra command-line flags for the launched browser, e.g.
     * ['--use-fake-device-for-media-stream', '--lang=fr']. Each is passed to the
     * engine as-is and wins over Vibium's defaults. Ignored in connect mode,
     * where the browser is already running elsewhere.
     */
    args?: string[];
    /**
     * Persistent browser profile directory, created if missing and reused
     * across sessions (cookies, logins survive). Omit for the default: a
     * temporary profile wiped on close. Ignored in connect mode.
     */
    userDataDir?: string;
}
```

### `StorageState`

    cookies: Cookie[];
    origins: OriginState[];
}

### `SwipeDirection`

```ts
type SwipeDirection = 'up' | 'down' | 'left' | 'right';
```

### `SwipeOptions`

```ts
interface SwipeOptions {
    /** Start at an edge or corner of the viewport, its center (default), or a point. */
    from?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'left' | 'right' | 'top-left' | 'top-right' | 'bottom-left' | 'bottom-right' | 'center' | {
        x: number;
        y: number;
    };
    /** Pixels to move (default: half the viewport). */
    distance?: number;
    /** 'slow', 'normal', 'fast', or pixels per second. Instead of duration. */
    speed?: 'slow' | 'normal' | 'fast' | number;
    /** Milliseconds the move takes (default 300). */
    duration?: number;
    /** Milliseconds to rest at the end before lifting. */
    hold?: number;
}
```
